title: The Thermodynamics of Cosmological Horizons and Their Holographic Description in de Sitter Space
summary: We analyse the laws of thermodynamics governing the behaviour of cosmological horizons in de Sitter space and their map to a holographic description at future infinity, $\mathcal{I}^+$. In this case, the boundary can receive signals from two cosmological horizons. We find a universal form for the first law of thermodynamics, valid in general circumstances, when matter-energy crosses both horizons and impinges on the boundary.
